message.content:
The magazine cover "TEMPO" for "19-25 OKTOBER 2015" features an illustration of a man with dark hair in a suit. His jacket, trousers, and right glove are a reflective gold color, while his left shoulder and sleeve are black. He wears a white shirt and a red necktie. Leaning forward against a black background, he holds a black pen in his bare left hand, poised to sign a white document resting on a podium draped with a fabric displaying the stars and stripes of the American flag.

The cover includes white text in Indonesian: "LOBI EMAS FREEPORT-ISTANA" on the left, and smaller text at the top: "PENUMPANG GELAP PENGAMPUNAN PAJAK" and "AMPUTASI KOMISI YUDISIAL." The title "TEMPO" is in large, gold-toned lettering across the top. At the bottom left, there is a barcode next to "RP 39.500," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273." A vertical red stripe runs down the left edge of the cover.
